body:
ListViewModel loads the list row exactly once in init (listsRepo.getById), not
as a Flow. Consequences:
- Rename the list in List properties, navigate back (same back-stack entry ->
  same ViewModel) -> old name state, and grouping still uses the old
  category_order after reordering categories in props.
- category_order/name changes arriving via sync from other devices never
  reflect while the screen is open.
- Independently, Nav.kt passes hardcoded scaffold titles: "List", "Registry",
  "List properties" — the actual list name (which ListUiState even carries) is
  never displayed anywhere on those screens. In a multi-list app you cannot
  tell which list you're looking at.

Fix: expose a Flow<ListEntity> from ListsRepo/ListDao (observeById), combine it
into ListUiState so name + categoryOrder are live; surface the real list name
in the top bar for list/registry/props destinations (pass through nav args or
hoist from the VM). Same staleness applies to ListPropsViewModel's init.
Also: sessionState.defaultCurrency is read once per VM — currency changes only
apply after process restart; fold into the same "make it live" pass if cheap.
title: Android: list name/category order go stale; top bar shows 'List' not the list's name
